author: Tom Evans, with Sam Illingworth
basis: First-person contemplative account and speculative interaction design
reported_outcomes: Evans reports clearer description of sensations and a calmer conversational rhythm.
proposed_outcomes: Use questions to notice bodily experience and attention.
limits: Reported tone and sensation changes are not validated meditation benefits.
Claims that AI recognized meditative depth from sparse words are interpretations.
The simulated-meditation framing encourages anthropomorphic assumptions and adds little to the already retained question-and-reflection routines.
review_note: Defer a standalone card. Preserve the useful boundary that the person reports sensations and judges distraction; revisit with a clearer non-speculative protocol.
coverage: Close-read all 156 lines of available extracted article text; image-only content and linked media not reviewed.
